name: email-task-agent
description: Standalone agent that extracts compliance tasks from email for human review and JSON export

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @email-task-agent/api" "npm run dev -w @email-task-agent/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @email-task-agent/api && npm run build -w @email-task-agent/web
